• **Director 2** – Independent Director (appointed 30 May 2003) | | **Shareholder(s)** | Director 1 – 100 % (individual) | | **Key Litigation** | One debt‑recovery case (CASE‑2022‑4166) filed in the Sessions Court (Kedah) – dismissed; claim RM 107,700. | --- ### Financial Highlights (FY 2022‑2024) | Year | Revenue (RM) | Gross Profit (RM) | Operating Profit (RM) | Net Profit (RM) | Total Assets (RM) | Total Liabilities (RM) | Equity (RM) | Quick Ratio | EBITDA (RM) | |------|--------------|-------------------|-----------------------|-----------------|-------------------|------------------------|------------|-------------|------------| | **2022** | 43.9 M | 20.3 M | **‑5.1 M** | **‑5.45 M** | 52.2 M | 13.9 M | 38.3 M | 1.62 | **‑3.44 M** | | **2023** | 48.3 M | 22.8 M | **‑1.15 M** | **‑1.51 M** | 57.4 M | 20.6 M | 36.8 M | 1.63 | **+0.70 M** | | **2024** | 57.99 M | 27.3 M | **+5.50 M** | **+3.85 M** | 68.97 M | 29.46 M | 39.51 M | 1.21 | **+7.72 M** | **Trend analysis (2022‑2024)** * **Revenue growth:** +32 % over three years, driven by higher service volumes. * **Profitability turnaround:** After two years of operating losses, the company posted a solid operating profit of RM 5.5 M and net profit of RM 3.85 M in FY 2024. EBITDA moved from negative (‑RM 3.44 M) to positive (RM 7.72 M). * **Margins:** Gross‑profit margin stable around 47 %; operating‑profit margin improved from –11.7 % (2022) to +9.5 % (2024). Net‑profit margin turned positive at 6.6 % in 2024. * **Liquidity:** Quick ratio stayed above 1.2, indicating comfortable short‑term liquidity, though cash‑to‑revenue fell to ~9.6 % in 2024 after a peak of 14.9 % in 2023. * **Capital structure:** Leverage rose from 0.36× (2022) to 0.75× (2024). Interest‑coverage turned strongly positive in 2024 (12.8×) after being negative in the prior two years. * **Cash flow:** Operating cash flow swung from a negative RM 2.68 M (2022) to a positive RM 6.12 M (2024); free cash flow became positive (RM 3.88 M) in 2024, supporting future growth or debt reduction. --- ### Overall Assessment Seri Everbright Klinik Sdn. Bhd. is a single‑shareholder, privately held elder‑care provider operating out of Kedah. After a period of losses in 2022‑2023, the firm achieved a clear profitability reversal in FY 2024, driven by higher revenues and tighter cost control. Liquidity remains solid, though cash generation relative to revenue is modest. The balance sheet shows a moderate increase in leverage, but the strong interest‑coverage ratio in 2024 suggests the company can comfortably service its debt. The only recorded litigation (a dismissed debt‑recovery claim) has no apparent financial impact. With a growing top line and emerging profitability, the company appears positioned for continued expansion in the home‑based senior‑care market, provided it maintains cost discipline and manages its rising leverage.
